author: SegmentLinking
body:
The `pLS_map{,_pos,_neg}_layer2_subdet4.bin` maps had no -z modules: the generator applied the disk-2 || > 2.3 cut to signed  (cms-sw/cmssw#52129). The files are read by the standalone LST.

All files are regenerated with the CMSSW `DumpLSTGeometry` analyzer (D121, pt 0.6 and 0.8), which includes the fix, so that the standalone uses the same maps that CMSSW builds at run time; the LSTGeometry python code that produced the previous files is being archived. Beyond the fix, the previous pixel maps had 3-5 % more connections (the python generator enlarged each sensor to a fixed 100  100/50 mm envelope), and the module map predates the CMSSW tightening, so standalone results change accordingly. Sensor centroids and orientations agree with the previous files to 5 m; the legacy 123456789 vertical-slope values are now written as inf, which the loader already treats the same. The README now explains how to regenerate the files (the `--geometry` option comes with cms-sw/cmssw#52129). The files match cms-sw/cmssw#52129: the dumped maps are byte-identical.

Validation: `lst::loadAndFillESDataHost` loads the new files with the same module counts as the previous ones (26401 modules, 13200 lower, 9104 endcap); pixel connections (generic, pt 0.8) 645360  634400; disk 2 has 96/96 modules on -z/+z.
title: Regenerate all files with the CMSSW DumpLSTGeometry analyzer, including the -z TEDD disk 2 fix
